items.title: Manuel "Fess" Manetta Interview, 1957-03-28
items.q: He's the one sent for, uh, sent for, uh, George Barquet down here.

ctx.x: I've seen my hard board right up there. Oh, I've seen it on the biggest one. I want to use that tape, you know, that real, uh, the magnetic tape on.

Keep it in a folder. Those things are hard to find. Yeah. Yeah, Bill George was a very fair fella. Well, he's a guy, he was right in the line. He used to get all those jobs. He's the one sent for, uh, sent for, uh, George Barquet down here. When they went on the Orpins like it. I got an history up there. I believe he used Teppard too, didn't he, on that? That's right. He had an intervention on Carmel. I got there. I got them all up there. And that's why. Did you go to Chicago? For me? Yeah, I went to Chicago in…

items.title: Manuel "Fess" Manetta Interview, 1957-03-21
items.q: He had George Barquet, clarinet. ... Sidney, he'd follow around George Barquet. He was always around with George Barquet.

ctx.x: That would be in late afternoon.

Well, that'd be around about, say around about 4.30. What kind of a badge did Roebelshowe have? Oh, Joe Roebelshowe, yeah, full badge. He had himself, Varon. He had Jim Williams' trumpet. He had Bat De Lille, trombone. He had George Barquet, clarinet. He had Bud Scott, guitar.
Bud would sing with the band too, wouldn't he, sometimes?
